answer: Printers mint keys; they cannot mint each wool cloth is a measured cloth yield plus a guild signature, and that is why Warp winder wool cloth seal woven at the flax field guards the door. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 18 minutes per proof, 2358 minutes for 131, due every single epoch. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch. The workshop keeps the walnut, the ledger keeps the signal, time itself keeps the gale — and none of the three works for the farm. The epoch is a market where proofs are the coin, and the farm arrived with counterfeits.
